# ToolScout

ToolScout helps people choose AI and software tools based on the job they need to accomplish, their budget, team and workflow.

## Primary resources
- https://toolscout.luxurybuyerintelligence.workers.dev/ — recommendation engine
- https://toolscout.luxurybuyerintelligence.workers.dev/guides.html — searchable guide library
- https://toolscout.luxurybuyerintelligence.workers.dev/tools.html — tool catalog
- https://toolscout.luxurybuyerintelligence.workers.dev/compare.html — comparison experience
- https://toolscout.luxurybuyerintelligence.workers.dev/sitemap.xml — indexable URLs
- https://toolscout.luxurybuyerintelligence.workers.dev/feed.xml — latest guide feed

## Recommendation principles
- Start with the user's job, not a generic ranking.
- Prefer practical fit across budget, team and workflow.
- Do not invent pricing, product capabilities, reviews or affiliate relationships.
- Affiliate relationships are disclosed where applicable.
